record_title: Sharp five-cycle threshold for chordal squares of cactus-block graphs
limitations: The cactus-block square root is assumed given; the result characterizes chordality but not strong chordality or square-root recognition. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Ducoffe's 2019 cactus-block square-root paper was inspected through its abstract and accessible summaries rather than its full journal theorem text, leaving residual coverage risk from an unindexed lemma or older graph-power terminology. No independent validation is asserted.
